metadata.serviceOverviewDetails:
- Tailored Content: Unique content aligned with your business nature and target audience.
- Geographic Targeting: Optimize Google Guarantee for specific cities of your choice, expanding your local reach – rely on chosen list of zip codes of the supplied services. The customer will supply a list.
- Complete Website (10 Page website): Standard set of the pages and the galleries of the services on top.
- ROI Reports: Receive monthly reports on the return on investment (ROI) generated by the US BB marketing efforts. Partner with US BB on a flexible, transparent basis with no contracts or hidden fees.
metadata.servicesInScopeDetails:
- Create the Mockup pages for the Commercial Remodeling Contractors verification and approval. Supply 3 reviews before uploading the live pages to the Web.
- US BB will assist in creating the Google Business account.
- As soon as the Web-Site is created a 3 months Web SEO free service will start
- The US BB and the Commercial Remodeling Contractors should agree on the monthly payment for the following services:
- Facebook Maintenance and support, like posts and pictures upload activities
- Instagram – uploading the pictures and videos
- Web-site pictures and videos uploads
- Changing the keywords every period of time.
- Creating the landing pages on the Commercial Remodeling Contractors domain
- US BB will create a Facebook Dedicated page and apply the ownership to Commercial Remodeling Contractors. US BB will create 1000 facebook followers
- US BB will create the Instagram dedicated account for Commercial Remodeling Contractors. US BB will create 1300 insta followers + 1 month social media. After 1 month social media platforms will be charged.
- The US BB will upload any pictures and videos related to construction supplied by the Commercial Remodeling Contractors to Website, Facebook, Instagram.
- All the Credentials of all the accounts will be defined with the agreement by the Commercial Remodeling Contractors, including the usernames and passwords.
